announcements.title: 30-Day Readmission Payment Policy
announcements.changeSummary: Replaces the prior 14-day readmission policy and expands the readmission review period to 30 days after discharge.
announcements.clientImpact: Hospital readmission claims may face a broader review window for separate reimbursement.
announcements.excerpt: The updated policy, effective October 1, 2026, expands the readmission review period to thirty days.

announcements.title: Claim and Code Review Program — new claim edits
announcements.changeSummary: Aetna says providers may see new claim edits beginning December 1, 2026.
announcements.clientImpact: Affected coding patterns should be reviewed before the effective date; specific edit detail may require the provider portal.
announcements.excerpt: Beginning December 1, 2026, you may see new claim edits.

announcements.program: Commercial and Medicare unless otherwise stated
announcements.title: Maternity coding and reimbursement restructuring
announcements.changeSummary: Maternity care coding moves away from the global maternity billing model toward more detailed service-based coding.
announcements.clientImpact: OB/GYN billing workflows and coding education may need updates before January 1, 2027.
announcements.excerpt: Effective January 1, 2027, maternity care coding will shift toward a more detailed service-based framework.
